WatchHomePromo.eyebrow: E taraaki n te mission ni kabane
WatchHomePromo.title: Te message e aki kangae. Te bwaai ni karaoaki e kangae.
WatchHomePromo.description: E kabaneaki naba te video library ao tools mai tibi n te aei, e kamwakamwakai naba te anditaki i doin te translation ki te platforms e kabaneaki n te taonga n te tangata.

WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Buokaki n te kamwakai te <highlight>generation n muri</highlight> n te mission tools
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: E kairakiaki tabei, creators, ao partners ki te early access. Karaoi te tools iou titem maira, tera te feedback, ao buokaki n te kareaki te products e kabaneaki n te mission work maoti.
